entities.summary: Bernard Charbonneau was a French writer who wrote about twenty books and numerous articles, published in La Gueule Ouverte, Foi et Vie, La République des Pyrénées. An apolitical and independent thinker, he is considered to be a major inspiration for various French ecological movements. His name is regularly mentioned by French academics. as well French green party leaders.
